from_speaker: a Silicon Valley Financial Crisis brewing
our_interpretation: This sentence announces a thesis about developing financial danger rather than specifying an observable crisis outcome.
Brewing does not distinguish rising vulnerability from a crisis that will actually occur.
Why I think expresses the speaker's confidence; it is not a conditional antecedent.
Adding defaults, failed fundraising or broken compute contracts as sufficient tests would add commitments not present in this sentence.
criteria.support_condition: No unique support condition can be specified without adding a definition of crisis and what counts as brewing.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No unique contradiction condition can be specified: continuing growth or the absence of a crisis over a chosen period would not disprove an undated claim of brewing danger.
